# activemodel

> ActiveModel: SQLModel with ActiveRecord-style developer ergonomics. ORM helpers, TypeID/whenever integrations, pytest fixtures, and JSONB mutation tracking.


2026, Michael Bianco

## Pages in this subsection

- [activemodel.types.typeid_patch](index.html.md): Add pydantic v2 support for TypeID. Importing file mutates the TypeID class from another package.
